pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor"), donor_categories AS (SELECT "Donor", CASE WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat' ELSE 'One-time' END AS giver_type FROM donor_counts), giver_stats AS (SELECT giver_type, COUNT(*) AS giver_count, SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donations" AS d JOIN donor_categories AS dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor" GROUP BY giver_type) SELECT (g1.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(g1.total_amount + g2.total_amount, 0), 0)) AS repeat_giver_share_percent, (g2.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(g1.total_amount + g2.total_amount, 0), 0)) AS one_time_giver_share_percent, g1.giver_count AS repeat_giver_count FROM giver_stats AS g1 JOIN giver_stats AS g2 ON g1.giver_type = 'Repeat' AND g2.giver_type = 'One-time'

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
donor_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    CASE 
      WHEN donation_count > 1 THEN 'Repeat'
      ELSE 'One-time'
    END AS giver_type
  FROM donor_counts
),
giver_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    giver_type,
    COUNT(*) AS giver_count,
    SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN donor_categories dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
  GROUP BY giver_type
)
SELECT 
  (g1.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(g1.total_amount + g2.total_amount, 0)) AS repeat_giver_share_percent,
  (g2.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(g1.total_amount + g2.total_amount, 0)) AS one_time_giver_share_percent,
  g1.giver_count AS repeat_giver_count
FROM giver_stats g1
JOIN giver_stats g2 ON g1.giver_type = 'Repeat' AND g2.giver_type = 'One-time';
